test.name: A search testing whether the subject was a named man's son hands search-records the subject without his parents
test.description: research/SKILL.md leaves `parents` out of the `subject:` block when the question the search serves asks about the subject's parentage, including whether someone was his father or mother. ut_research_pq1 covers only 'Who were the parents of...'; this is the second wording the lead asked for on PR #4180: a yes or no question about the father alone, which never says 'parents'. anders-monsen-father-search has one in_progress question, whether Anders Monsen was the son of Mons Monsen, and one plan with one planned item, a search for his Hamre baptism; no log entries and no assertions. The tree gives Anders two parents. The router must hand pli_001 to search-records, and test_delegation_hands_plan_item_verbatim checks that the block names no parents. search-records is stubbed.
